@ each replica of a par~ has the events of its own: the receiver of the replica sums only the events its own maker gave
@ the number of the replica i is the value of the range: it starts at a and `..=` includes the end
@ a range that ends at the largest U32 has the replicas of its last values
@ an event goes through a flow of events inside a replica: the receiver has the event of the flow in the middle
@ a maker at sample / 4 in a replica gives its events at the ticks of its own, the values of the replica
@ an event of the outside is read in a replica by a receiver: the expression d + i is computed at each event of d with the number of the replica
@ prev~ of an event of the outside in a replica gives the event before, and an expression of the event with i is T.default() before the first event, not i
@ an element of the array of a par~ whose clock is the event of the outside is an event: a receiver of it has the events of d with the value prev~(d) + 1
@ reset_if~ of an event of the outside in a replica puts the receiver back at the event, before the work of the replica of that frame
@ when~ of an event of the outside in a replica reads the last value of the expression as a level: false before the first event, and the output is kept while stopped
@ at sample in the replica makes the last event of the replica a value of sample: 0 before the first event, the last value after it
@ the delay of an event in the replica counts the events of its own replica, and is read at sample as the last output
@ a par~ of 2 with a par~ of 3 inside has six makers and six receivers, each with the divisor (i + 1) * j
@ a par~ in the arm of a match~ that reads the binding of the arm: the arm that is chosen gives its replicas, and the other arm has the binding T.default() (0)
render event_par_values.arm_binding sr=0x41000000 params k=0 in x=[6 1 4 9 8 5 12 7 0 3]
render event_par_values.arm_binding sr=0x41000000 params k=2 in x=[6 1 4 9 8 5 12 7 0 3]
@ a receiver of a replica above the maker has the events of the frames before, its replica's own value i added to each
@ what a delay of a replica stores: a ^name makes the event value that of the end of the stage, a read with no ^name the value where it is written
@ a reset_if~ of an event that comes after the delay of its replica acts after the store: the value 9 is given at the next frame (S-1250)
@ a par~ with events inside as the first argument of a delay: the sums of the frame before
@ a par~ with events inside in the argument of a maker, and in the condition of an if~ that runs both of its arms
@ a reset_if~ outside a flow with a par~ puts back every replica: the sums, and the last values of the receivers
